pages.title: Raw Anti-Gold
pages.text: Cold blue in the light of the Antiverse sky. Under a white lamp it is gold-coloured after all: colour depends on electrons, and positrons behave exactly the same.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Found in veins in the antistone, shining blue-white under the copper sky.
